copy_failed: Copy failed: select the code and copy it by hand.
warning: It will never be shown again. With it, you can choose a new password if you lose the old one; without it, an account whose password is forgotten is lost. Keep it off this device (password manager, paper) and do not share it.
saved: I have written down my recovery code
forgot_intro: Enter the recovery code you were given at sign-up. All your sessions will be closed and a new code will be issued to you.
settings_hint: Without an email address, this code is the only way to get your account back if you forget your password. Generating a new one replaces the old one.
new_code_intro: Here is your new code. The old one no longer works.
